# #232 Coach-pattern day templates and the coach rubric ## Parent
#224
## What to build
Day templates follow the design elite coaches share: coach exercise ordering, a low starting weekly volume, 2-3x weekly frequency per muscle and the staples every coach includes. A code-scored coach rubric guards this in CI.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Day templates follow coach ordering: priority or small muscles may open a day and pre-exhaust is allowed; two hard compounds for the same muscle are never back to back after a pre-exhaust unless the coach template does so - [ ] Every player starts at 4-6 weekly working sets per muscle, whatever their level - [ ] Each muscle is trained 2-3 times a week; calves, side delts and adductors are always present - [ ] Glute priority is an optional emphasis, not the default for female players - [ ] The LLM split prompt carries the same rules, and its output still passes the existing sanitiser - [ ] A coach rubric runs as plain pytest over a matrix of profiles (experience x days 3/4/5 x Equipment access, glute priority on/off) and checks weekly sets per muscle in band, 2-3x frequency, majority machine/cable/Smith for gym players, staple coverage and zero band or bodyweight working sets for Commercial gym players
